item.title: CV
item.description:
My CV

Note: This page is a work in progress. Hopefully it still gives you the information you need.
Last updated: June 2026

Email: hello@zoravur.com
Personal web page: zoravur.com
Bachelor of Computer Science, University of Waterloo

Email is the best way to reach me.

Education

  • Bachelor of Computer Science, Honours
    Minor in Pure Mathematics
    University of Waterloo
    2018-2024

Research Projects

  • Formalizing implementation of Simply Typed Lambda Calculus in Lean4. — May 2026 — Ongoing
  • Formalized an implementation of insertion sort in Lean4, proving permutation and ordering lemmas. — May 2026

Research Experience

  • Research Assistant — September 2022
    • Formalized an independent/alternative Coq mechanization of CC<:□ in A-normal form, under supervision from Prof. Ondřej Lhoták and Edward Lee.

Professional Experience

  • Software Developer
    Solutions That Matter
    January 2024 — Present
    • Developing order processing and financial reconciliation software.
  • Software Developer Intern
    Dealmaker
    2023
    • Assisted with Business Analytics and Intelligence by writing SQL.
  • AI Engineering Intern
    Royal Bank of Canada
    September 2021 — April 2022
    • Created an order matching engine as part of the test bed for the RL trading model Aiden.
  • Instructional Support Assistant
    University of Waterloo
    January 2021 — April 2021
    • Assisted with teaching, office hours, marking, and updating the course website.
  • Software Developer Intern
    Arcturus Networks
    May 2020 — August 2020
    • Built the companion web app for controlling and configuring our IoT edge inference platform.
  • Software Developer Intern
    ROSS Intelligence
    May 2019 — August 2019
    • Built the subscription page, developed a demo mode for the core app, and ran many A/B tests as part of Growth Engineering.
